name: Desktop onboarding settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Desktop onboarding settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Automatically launch the Company Portal app and display status for remaining configuration
properties.description: If the Company Portal app is not configured to install in system context, assigned to the Device group, and selected in the list of Apps, it will not launch automatically and display onboarding status.
